words.example: But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street. Fewer artist than scientists responded to the Nature poll, however,several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study. The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work. Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
